result: The company dashboard projects the 268/269 read models into revenue, costs, profit, cash, fleet value and company level, with a 12-month chart/table, cost breakdown, last ride and purchase/upgrade offers. Missing months are null/'fără date', real zero and negative values stay visible. Purchases and upgrades require confirmation and call the real 269 ports; insufficient cash, level and duplicates are refused explicitly. Focus, Tab, Escape, pause surface, no global listeners, 10 Hz updates and zero closed-panel reads are verified.
limitations: The browser fixture runs the real 268/269/270 modules but not a full Babylon world; the live-shell probe verifies mounting, surface and focus, not an upgrade purchase inside the live world because that world has no prepared level/profit. No FPS/GPU claim; UI cost is structural under the targeted policy. KPI popup (267), persistence (278), physics (282) and learning remain separate. Local Node is 24.19.0 below 24.21.0; the browser probe used an external PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE.
